title: EIC Accelerator Onboarding Survey Import
name: eic_accelerator_onboarding_survey_import
description:
This FormProcessor ingests the EU Survey EIC Onboarding survey for the ACCELERATOR scheme. It is scheme-specific: other schemes have their own onboarding surveys with different questions, so each scheme has its own survey-import FormProcessor. (The Company Import and Individual Import FormProcessors, by contrast, are common across all schemes.)

It creates an activity that stores the received EU Survey data and attaches it to a case. The case is identified by:

- the received `PIC Number`, matched to the corresponding custom field of the case
- the case title, which is supposed to be set to `EIC Awardee Onboarding`.

This FormProcessor also creates an individual contact from the transmitted contact data if no contact yet exists that matches the received contact data (First Name, Last Name, Professional Email).
